task: A client asks for a number you don't have with you. Say so and promise to send it later.
say: How many users are on the old system?
zh: 客户问一个你手头没有的数字。如实说明，并答应稍后发给他。对方说：旧系统上有多少用户？
example: I don't have that number to hand, sorry. I'll check and let you know straight after the meeting.

task: Your manager asks a simple question, but you can't remember the answer. Say you'll check today.
say: When does the licence expire?
zh: 经理问了一个简单的问题，但你记不起来答案。说你今天会去查。对方说：许可证什么时候到期？
example: Good question. I'm not sure off the top of my head. Let me check and get back to you this afternoon.

task: A client asks about a system another colleague built. Say it's not your area and name the right person.
say: Can you tell us how the payroll integration works?
zh: 客户问起一个由其他同事负责的系统。说明这不是你的领域，并指出该问谁。对方说：你能给我们讲讲工资系统的集成是怎么做的吗？
example: That's not really my area, I'm afraid. Aroha built it, so she'd be the best person to ask.

task: Your team leader asks a question you need a moment to think about. Buy a little time, then give a first idea.
say: What do you think is causing the slowdown?
zh: 组长问了一个你需要想一想的问题。先争取一点时间，再说出初步想法。对方说：你觉得变慢的原因是什么？
example: Hmm, let me think about that for a sec. My first guess would be the database, but I'd need to check the logs.

task: Someone notices a mistake in a meeting invite you sent. Admit it and say how you'll fix it.
say: The invite has the wrong date on it.
zh: 有人发现你发的会议邀请有错误。承认错误，并说明你会怎么改正。对方说：邀请上的日期写错了。
example: Oh, sorry, that's my mistake. I'll send out a corrected invite straight after this.

task: Your manager asks if a job is finished. You think so, but you're not completely sure. Say what you know and promise to confirm.
say: Have the patches been applied to all the servers?
zh: 经理问一项工作完成了没有。你觉得完成了，但不完全确定。说出你知道的情况，并答应确认。对方说：所有服务器都打好补丁了吗？
example: I'm not a hundred percent sure. I know most are done, but I'll double-check and confirm by this afternoon.

task: A client asks for a price on the spot. You don't want to guess. Promise a proper answer by a set day.
say: What would it cost to add another fifty users?
zh: 客户当场问价格。你不想乱猜。答应在某个具体日期前给出准确答复。对方说：再加五十个用户要多少钱？
example: I'd rather not guess and give you the wrong number. Let me work it out properly and send it through by Friday.

task: A client asks about something you only partly know. Say what you know, be clear about what you don't, and give a date.
say: Will the upgrade affect our mobile users?
zh: 客户问的事情你只知道一部分。说出你知道的，讲清楚不确定的部分，再给一个日期。对方说：升级会影响我们的手机用户吗？
example: From what I know, it shouldn't. But I haven't tested it on mobile yet, so I'll confirm that by Wednesday.

task: A client asks about the support contract, which isn't your job. Say so, and say who you'll check with and when.
say: Is the new firewall covered by our support contract?
zh: 客户问支持合同的事，这不归你管。如实说明，再说你会找谁确认、什么时候回复。对方说：新防火墙在我们的支持合同范围内吗？
example: I'm not across the contract side, sorry. I'll check with our account manager and come back to you tomorrow.

task: Your manager points out that the numbers in your report are wrong. Admit the mistake simply and say when you'll fix it.
say: These numbers in your report don't add up.
zh: 经理指出你报告里的数字有错。简单地承认错误，并说什么时候改好。对方说：你报告里这些数字对不上。
example: You're right, my mistake. I think I pulled the wrong month. I'll fix it and resend it this afternoon.

task: A client asks for your recommendation on a big decision. You need time to think it through. Say so and give a day.
say: So which option would you recommend?
zh: 客户就一个重大决定请你给建议。你需要时间仔细考虑。如实说明，并给一个日期。对方说：那你推荐哪个方案？
example: I'd like to give that some proper thought rather than answer on the spot. Can I come back to you with a recommendation on Monday?

task: Someone asks why an old system was set up a certain way. It was before you joined. Say so and offer to look into it.
say: Why was the network set up like this in the first place?
zh: 有人问一个旧系统当初为什么这样搭建。那是你入职之前的事。如实说明，并主动提出去查一查。对方说：网络当初为什么要这样搭？
example: That was before my time, unfortunately. I'll dig through the old design docs and see if there's a reason written down.

task: Last meeting you promised to find something out. Now they ask you. You have the answer. Give it and confirm in writing.
say: Did you find out about the backup retention?
zh: 上次会议你答应去查一件事，现在对方问起。你已经有答案了。说出来，并答应书面确认。对方说：备份保留期的事你查到了吗？
example: Yes, I did. It's thirty days for daily backups and a year for monthly ones. I'll put that in an email as well.

task: Your manager asks about a task you forgot to do. Be honest, say sorry briefly, and give a new time.
say: Did you get a chance to look at the cost report?
zh: 经理问起一项你忘记做的任务。诚实地说，简短道歉，再给一个新的时间。对方说：成本报告你看过了吗？
example: Sorry, not yet. It slipped through the cracks this week. I'll have it done by lunchtime tomorrow.

task: A client asks for a discount. That's not your decision. Say who decides and when they'll hear back.
say: Can you give us a discount if we sign up for three years?
zh: 客户要求打折。这不是你能决定的。说明由谁决定，以及什么时候会给答复。对方说：如果我们签三年，能给个折扣吗？
example: Fair question, but it's not my call. I'll raise it with our account manager, and someone will get back to you this week.

task: On an incident call, a manager asks for the root cause. You don't know yet. Say what you do know and when the full report will come.
say: So what caused the outage?
zh: 在故障电话会上，一位经理问根本原因。你还不知道。说出目前已知的情况，以及完整报告什么时候出来。对方说：那这次宕机是什么原因造成的？
example: We don't know the root cause yet. What we do know is it started straight after the 2 a.m. update. We'll have a full report to you within forty-eight hours.

task: In a design review, a senior architect asks a hard question. You can answer half of it. Answer that part and follow up on the rest.
say: How will this design handle a failure in the Australia East region?
zh: 设计评审会上，一位资深架构师问了一个难题。你能回答一半。先回答这部分，其余的稍后跟进。对方说：如果 Australia East 区域出故障，这个设计怎么应对？
example: Part of it I can answer now: the web tier fails over automatically. The database side I need to confirm, so I'll come back to you on that by Thursday.

task: Earlier in this meeting you gave the wrong date. Now someone repeats your mistake. Correct yourself clearly.
say: Okay, so we'll plan the cutover for the 12th then.
zh: 这次会议早些时候你说错了日期，现在有人照着你的错误在说。清楚地更正自己。对方说：好，那我们把切换安排在 12 号。
example: Actually, sorry, I need to correct what I said earlier. The 12th is the testing date. The cutover is the 19th.

task: A client asks for an estimate on the spot. Give a rough range, make it clear it's not final, and say what you need for a real estimate.
say: Roughly how long will the migration take?
zh: 客户要你当场估算时间。给一个大概的范围，说明这不是最终答案，再说出准确估算需要什么。对方说：迁移大概要多久？
example: Very roughly, six to eight weeks, but please don't hold me to that. I'll give you a proper estimate once I've seen the full server list.

task: Your change caused a problem yesterday. The team lead asks who did it. Own it, say what you've done, and what you'll do next time.
say: Does anyone know who changed the firewall rules yesterday?
zh: 你昨天的变更引起了问题。组长问是谁做的。主动承认，说明你已经做了什么，以及下次会怎么做。对方说：有人知道昨天谁改了防火墙规则吗？
example: That was me, sorry. I didn't realise it would block the reporting server. I've rolled it back, and next time I'll put it through the change process properly.

task: A question comes up that only someone outside the meeting can answer. Say who knows and how you'll share the answer.
say: Can someone explain why we're paying for these extra licences?
zh: 有一个问题只有不在场的人能回答。说明谁知道，以及你会怎么把答案分享给大家。对方说：有人能解释一下为什么我们要为这些额外的许可证付费吗？
example: I think Raj in procurement would know. He's not on this call, but I'll ask him and post the answer in the Teams channel.

task: You promised a client an answer last week but haven't delivered. They remind you. Apologise, explain briefly, and commit to a new date.
say: You said you'd get back to us on the pricing last week.
zh: 你上周答应给客户答复，但一直没给。对方提醒你。道歉、简单解释，并承诺新的日期。对方说：你说过上周会给我们报价答复的。
example: You're right, and I'm sorry for the delay. I'm still waiting on the vendor. I've chased them again, and I'll update you by Wednesday either way.

task: At a steering meeting, the finance director asks a big question you can't answer now. Stay confident and promise a clear follow-up.
say: What's the total cost of ownership over five years?
zh: 指导委员会会议上，财务总监问了一个你现在答不上来的大问题。保持自信，承诺清晰的后续跟进。对方说：五年的总拥有成本是多少？
example: I don't want to give you a number I can't stand behind. I'll put together a five-year breakdown with the assumptions and send it before the next steering meeting.

task: A client asks if something is possible. The honest answer is 'it depends'. Explain briefly and promise a clear yes or no.
say: Can the system fail over automatically between our two data centres?
zh: 客户问某件事能不能做到。诚实的回答是“看情况”。简单解释，并承诺给出明确的答复。对方说：系统能在我们两个数据中心之间自动故障切换吗？
example: In principle, yes, but it depends on your network links and the app itself. Let me check with our architect and come back with a clear yes or no by Friday.

task: A client asks an important compliance question, and your manager is listening. You think you know, but you're not sure. Don't make it up.
say: Is all our data stored only in New Zealand?
zh: 客户问了一个重要的合规问题，你的经理也在场。你觉得你知道，但不确定。不要乱说。对方说：我们所有的数据都只存放在新西兰吗？
example: I believe some of it's in Australia, but this is important, so I want to be certain. I'll confirm the exact regions in writing by tomorrow.
